pages.title: Coverage
pages.text: All 19 authored deep realms ship layered trials, spawnable named bosses and non-empty loot. See the Secret Realm Playbook for full rules.

pages.title: Sessions
pages.text: UUID SavedData sessions handle timers, party, death eject and offline expiry. Clears fire onRealmCleared.

pages.title: Traps and Entry
pages.text: Traps deploy through FormationFieldService. Bound gates reserve exact ticket NBT; clients cannot bypass entity gates.

pages.title: Reward Redlines
pages.text: First/repeat loot splits, atomic encounter claims and NBT escrow chests block hoppers and foreign players.
